39:75.text: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne
from all round, glorifying the praises of their Lord
will be judged with truth. And it will be said, "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn

40:2.text: is from Allâh, the All-Mighty, the All-Knower.

40:3.text: The Forgiver of sin, the Acceptor of repentance, the Severe in punishment, the Bestower
(none has the right to be worshipped but He)
, to Him is the final return.

40:4.text: (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
of Allâh but those who disbelieve. So let not their ability of going about here and there through the land
[O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, for their ultimate end will be the Fire of Hell]

40:5.text: and the Confederates after them denied
nation plotted against their Messenger to seize him, and disputed by means of falsehood to refute therewith the truth. So I seized them

40:6.text: Thus has the Word of your Lord been justified against those who disbelieved, that they will be the dwellers of the Fire.

40:7.text: and those around it glorify the praises of their Lord, and believe in Him, and ask forgiveness for those who believe
: "Our Lord! You comprehend all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who repent and follow Your Way, and save them from the torment of the blazing Fire!
